about_the_game:
This place was once the Valley of Spiritual Beasts recorded in the Classic of Mountains and Seas, a land full of fairylike aura and spiritual energy. Unfortunately, this land has been invaded by an evil force known as puppets, which, like the monsters in the Classic of Mountains and Seas, have brought endless disasters to this land. To heal this fairyland, you will revitalize the land by synthesizing elements from the Classic of Mountains and Seas—spiritual beasts, spiritual beast eggs, ancient trees, treasures, stars, and fairy flowers.

Lavish Realism: The game features a lavish and realistic art style, combining traditional Chinese themes from the Classic of Mountains and Seas with Western aesthetic concepts to create a unique visual experience.

International Perspective: In terms of design, the game has especially taken into account the aesthetics of international players, enabling the game's graphics to showcase the charm of Chinese traditional culture while attracting the attention of players worldwide.

Level-Progression Mode: Players need to use strategy and wisdom to solve a series of puzzles based on the Classic of Mountains and Seas. With each level cleared, players can obtain rich rewards to help the spiritual beasts fend off the evil puppets and protect the fairyland from invasion.

Fairy Island Mode: On this mysterious island, players can use the elements obtained from clearing levels to continuously synthesize and cultivate high-level spiritual beasts, making them your guardians and companions.

Spiritual Beast Synthesis: Players can create unique spiritual beasts by collecting various mysterious spiritual beast eggs, each with its own specific abilities and charm.

Fairyland Defense: The puppets in the game are the challenges players need to face. They will keep trying to invade your fairyland. Players need to use strategy to set up defenses and repel the puppet attacks.

Fairyland Construction: Players can build various facilities on their fairy island, such as spiritual beast habitats, treasure warehouses, and fairy art research institutes, to continuously improve the prosperity of the fairy island.

Cultural Fusion: Through international art design, the game combines Chinese traditional culture with global aesthetics, allowing players to experience a brand-new cultural fusion.

Strategic Challenge: In the level-progression mode, players need to use strategy to solve puzzles, collect elements, and enhance their own strength.

Spiritual Beast Cultivation: In the Fairy Island mode, players can cultivate their own spiritual beasts, helping them grow and evolve into powerful guardians.

Players can purchase spiritual stones by paying through the in-game store, which will redirect them to the Steam Inventory Store page, or they can directly pay through the Steam Inventory Store page and then enter the game to collect the spiritual stones.

You can purchase the Spirit Beast Pearl at the corresponding price tier directly from the inventory store or by jumping to the purchase option within the game：

Renminbi（￥）: 2 12 18 25 38 198 328 428 648

US Dollar（＄）： 0.3 1.5 2 3 4.99 25 45 59.99 89.99

The corresponding number of Spirit Beast Pearls that can be obtained：20 150 240 350 560 2400 3840 5000 8000

Rare items and the stamina required to enter levels can be purchased using Spirit Beast Pearls, which are a valuable in-game currency.
